# Softec AI Solution

> Custom Software Development, Generative AI Agents, Cloud & DevOps Engineering, and Cybersecurity Solutions.

## About Softec AI Solution
Softec AI Solution (https://softecai.com) is an enterprise software engineering and artificial intelligence innovation company headquartered in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, serving modern startups, scale-ups, and global enterprises. We architect scalable full-stack web and mobile systems, autonomous agentic AI workflows, high-throughput cloud backends, and cybersecurity architectures.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- Custom Software Development (https://softecai.com/services/custom-software-development): High-performance SaaS applications, microservices, enterprise web systems, and API integrations.
- Generative AI & Autonomous Agents (https://softecai.com/services/generative-ai-ai-agent-development): Custom LLM fine-tuning, autonomous task agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) platforms, and intelligent business chatbots.
- Cloud Computing & Migration (https://softecai.com/services/cloud-computing-cloud-migration): AWS, GCP, DigitalOcean infrastructure, serverless architecture, and 99.99% high availability.
- DevOps & CI/CD Automation (https://softecai.com/services/devops-cicd): Kubernetes orchestration, Docker containerization, automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, and infrastructure as code.
- Mobile Application Development (https://softecai.com/services/mobile-application-development): Native iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin), and cross-platform Flutter solutions.
- Cybersecurity & Compliance (https://softecai.com/services/cybersecurity-consulting): Vulnerability assessment and penetration testing (VAPT), zero-trust architecture, and SOC2 compliance.
- SaaS Product Development (https://softecai.com/services/saas-product-development): Multi-tenant architecture, MVP engineering, and subscription platform scaling.
- Business Process Automation (https://softecai.com/services/business-process-automation): Workflow automation, enterprise RPA, and custom webhook connectors.

## Primary Technologies
- Backend & Frameworks: PHP 8.4, Laravel, Python, Node.js, Go
- Frontend & UI: TypeScript, React, Vue.js, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS
- AI & ML: OpenAI GPT models, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, LangChain, LlamaIndex, PyTorch, Hugging Face
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Vector Databases (Pinecone, Qdrant)
- Cloud & Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Linux (Ubuntu), Nginx, Caddy, AWS, GCP
